data.name: Nitin
data.gender_notes: Nitin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nitin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nidhana' meaning 'to bestow'. This name signifies the one who brings joy and pleasure to others. The name Nitin is also associated with Lord Shiva, a major Hindu deity, and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. The name Nitin carries the meaning “Joy, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nitin usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Nitin holds a special significance as it is believed that the name is bestowed upon individuals by Lord Shiva himself. It is believed that those named Nitin are blessed with prosperity and good fortune, and are often seen as protectors and providers for their families and communities. This name is a reminder of the importance of selflessness and gratitude, and the power of giving to bring happiness and joy to oneself and others.

vedic_reference.note: Nitin is a name found in Hindu mythology, specifically in the Mahabharata. It is the name of a sage and a charioteer of Arjuna. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nit' which means 'truth' or 'established in truth'. Nitin is also considered a form of the god Vishnu.
